scenarios.title: With notifications enabled and two live owner observations, a newly gated watcher action shows one native Watcher approval requested banner; folded repeats do not show another. Clicking opens that watcher's Heimdall detail. Use an isolated fixture kind, never real provider work.

A watcher entering terminal from a previous live observation shows one native Watcher reached a terminal state banner with state and reason. Disabled notifications and startup-restored terminal watchers show none. Clicking opens its Heimdall detail. Use an isolated fixture kind.
